title: Thick Blood vs. Cholesterol (Stroke & Paralysis Prevention)
description: Arterial blockage, stroke (Falaj), and heart attacks are caused by excessively thick blood forming clots in brain and heart pathways—cholesterol alone is not the primary culprit. Keeping blood naturally thin is key to survival.
body: Arterial blockage, stroke (Falaj), and heart attacks are caused by excessively thick blood forming clots in brain and heart pathways—cholesterol alone is not the primary culprit. Keeping blood naturally thin is key to survival.

title: Herbal Blood Thinning Protocol (Haldi, Saunf & Mulatthi)
description: Blend Turmeric (Haldi), Fennel (Saunf), Licorice (Mulatthi), Ginger, and Garlic to naturally thin thick blood. Take for 1 week and pause for 1 week. Can be continued for 1 month up to 6 months based on condition.
body: Blend Turmeric (Haldi), Fennel (Saunf), Licorice (Mulatthi), Ginger, and Garlic to naturally thin thick blood. Take for 1 week and pause for 1 week. Can be continued for 1 month up to 6 months based on condition.
urduText: ہلدی، سونف اور ملٹھی کا آمیزہ خون کو پتلا کرتا ہے۔ ایک ہفتہ استعمال کریں اور ایک ہفتہ وقفہ دیں۔

title: Dietary Warnings for High Blood Pressure & Stroke Patients
description: Patients at risk of stroke or recovering from paralysis must strictly avoid commercial broiler chicken and pigeon meat due to their extremely hot nature. Limit mutton to once a week in light broth (Yakhni) and emphasize vegetables.
